lines: Because my throat is thirsty.
I swallow the tide.
The city tastes salty.
The drop is sweet.
I licked it a little too much.
Because I was rushing too much.
It’s all the things I overlooked.
Inside the guardrail.
The earnest simple lyrics no longer reach.
I’ve been the same ever since, unchanged.
I wandered the night without meaning, crossing dusk.
They say it’ll heal by morning, repeating that it’s back to normal.
Tonight again, a dream fraud, a dream thief,
It’s an avalanche.
Tokyo, a fierce battlefield.
So I don’t indulge in foolish fantasies, don’t look, don’t wake, don’t awaken.
Today it’s too easy to understand; everywhere the choices are only red or blue.
And since then we probably keep trembling about tomorrow, don’t we?
I’m scared of myself, having become accustomed to the blinding light so quickly.
Even when satisfied, I couldn’t be fulfilled.
Breathing has become much harder than before.
Perhaps I’m still lost.
Cold, cold, cold, cold, an unstable night.
People like that comfort me.
Because they comfort me.
I’ve been the same ever since, I haven’t changed.
Didn’t the city and you all change lazily, sluggishly?
Or is it you, you? No, it’s me.
Still, I keep waiting just as I always have.
When you get what you want, everything else fades away.
That’s how, from now on,
Though it’s certainly here, it disappears.
It’s really pointless, huh.
We always stand right in the middle of cowardice.
I once thought the poster I saw in the city was cool.
Because I’ll soon get bored of it.
I’ll bite it before it melts.
It hurts terribly.
It hurts terribly, though.
